_comment: Offsets database for php2shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619). Each entry maps a fingerprint (distro + arch + SAPI + exact PHP version) to the build-specific constants the full chain needs. Append entries with: python3 derive_offsets.py <libphp.so> --append-db --distro <d> --arch <a> --sapi <s> --php-version <v> --dtor <0x...>

builds.note: Official php:8.4.26-apache image (Debian 13). Verified end-to-end RCE in this repo's lab.
